{{Kunark Era}}{{Spellpagesmart| | spellname = Succor | spellicon = V | description = Opens a mystical portal that transports your group to a relatively safe location in the current zone. The chaotic nature of the portal drains mana from anyone who passes through it. See [[Travel Guide#Evacuate_Locations|the travel guide]] for locations.
